name: 百毅靓之怒
status: design preview only; awaiting visual and parameter approval; no runtime implementation
scope: All occupied towers damage +50%; prior road-wide damage and slow concept superseded
prompt:
Use case: game VFX concept / compositing.
Create a polished landscape 3:2 game skill-effect design board for the Chinese WeChat portrait village tower-defense game 代代守村.
This is a NEW alternative to the former road shockwave design: the skill is now purely ALL OCCUPIED TOWERS ATTACK DAMAGE +50%, NOT area damage, NOT slowing, NOT burning a road.
Exact skill name “百毅靓之怒” (five characters: 百 毅 靓 之 怒). No extra 力.
Input 1 is the approved style reference for crisp cozy chibi 3D-prerendered 2D game art, sculpted wooden towers, soft grounded shadows and rounded enemies.
Input 2 is the actual current game's village map layout reference; preserve curving road, three or four grass-side tower pads, gate, trees and camera. Crop away mobile notch and UI. Use this composition as the base for the left battlefield.
Input 3 is the specific ice-crystal frost tower silhouette and material reference; its cyan crystal must remain cyan when buffed.

Design-sheet layout: cream ivory background, restrained gold outlines, dark brown legible Chinese titles, elegantly aligned. Top exact title “百毅靓之怒”; subtitle “全塔伤害 +50% · 持续 15 秒”. Tiny footer “技能特效概念稿 · 非运行截图”.
Left half: a large elevated orthographic battlefield crop, gate at bottom, winding road, green grass, trees. Show an occupied wooden crossbow tower left, a stone-throwing wooden catapult right, and a smaller cyan-crystal frost tower on the lower grass shoulder, all OFF the road. Three chibi red-bandit/boar/armored enemies travel on the road toward the gate with small health bars. Do not change all tower positions into one row, do not put towers on the road. Their relative sizes believable and slightly smaller than the close-ups.
The skill visual is LOCAL TO EACH TOWER: warm crimson-gold charging rim around the weapon mounting point, very short soft upward aura accents immediately hugging the tower top, subtle narrow base ellipse rooted at each tower, crisp thin luminous edges. Readable tower wood and bolts remain visible. Towers are NOT on fire. During attack, ordinary small projectiles have just a narrow warm highlight and very short streak: wooden arrow still arrow-shaped, thrown rock stays gray/brown with a red-gold edge, frost projectile keeps cyan center with a fine amber outline. Do NOT enlarge projectile sizes or add big tails; preserve visual clarity. One enemy near the center displays a small sharp red-gold hit burst at the contact point plus a brief red hit rim. Other enemies are normal colors. No road overlay, no ground-wide shockwave, no new enemy debuff markers, no fire carpets, no lightning, no giant glowing circles across the road, no particles or fireworks. The scene must feel attainable with 2D overlays and alpha/scale/tint animation.

Right half: upper two thirds, THREE equally sized neatly aligned tower close-up cards, one per tower type, in a horizontal row on a pale sage/cream surface. Labels “箭塔”, “石塔”, “寒塔”. Each shows matching local crimson-gold weapon glow. Frost crystal remains bright cyan with restrained warm glow near its mount. Beneath each tower, show one carefully separated tiny normal projectile and the buffed version with a slim arrow between: SAME physical size, small highlight addition only. Clear margins.
Lower right: a three-step horizontal visual strip with labels “发动”, “持续”, “命中”. “发动”: one compact red-gold flash at a crossbow weapon. “持续”: same tower with much quieter breathing red rim, no explosion. “命中”: close-up of a bandit struck by a small arrow and a compact red-gold impact star, enough face/body remains visible. Avoid giant sparks and clouds.
At the very bottom a slim paired informational caption only, not an actual skill menu: “大王之心：攻速 +50%” and “百毅靓之怒：伤害 +50%”. They are alternatives, no stacking claim.
Quality: crisp high definition, warm saturated pastoral game palette, toy-like chibi 3D-prerendered imagery with soft ambient occlusion, transparent-looking minimal effect shapes. Not pixel art, not photoreal, not a fantasy illustration detached from actual gameplay. Chinese text must be exact and fully legible. Do not add any further long text, numerical damage popups, UI buttons or gratuitous decoration.
